Its errors are of three kinds: attributions ('The proposal here' is not in 2212.06086 §6.3, and [14] does include a dark-matter paper, Minic 2020); an unsupported 'static' dual space, which the papers call dynamical; and an inference that the papers' own item 3(b) refutes, namely that the dark sector lives in the electric–magnetic E8 factor.
